name: kofc9544-api
description: Example application for running a Node Express app on AWS Lambda using Amazon API Gateway.

scripts.invoke-lambda: cross-var aws lambda invoke --function-name $npm_package_config_functionName --region $npm_package_config_region --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --payload file://api-gateway-event.json lambda-invoke-response.json && cat lambda-invoke-response.json
scripts.sam:deploy:stage: cross-var sam deploy  --stack-name $npm_package_config_cloudFormationStackNameStage --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --s3-bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketNameStage --s3-prefix $npm_package_name --parameter-overrides DomainName=$npm_package_config_domainStage Certificate=$npm_package_config_certificateStage=$STAGE RDSHost=$RDS_HOST RDSDBName=kofc_stage DbHost=$DB_HOST TokenSecret=$TOKEN_SECRET DbUserName=$DB_USERNAME DbName=$DB_NAME DbPassword=$DB_PASSWORD NodeEnv=$NODE_ENV  CacheId=$npm_package_config_cacheIdStage  --region $npm_package_config_region --no-fail-on-empty-changeset --force-upload
scripts.sam:deploy:production: cross-var sam deploy --stack-name $npm_package_config_cloudFormationStackNameProduction --capabilities CAPABILITY_IAM --s3-bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketNameProduction --s3-prefix $npm_package_name --parameter-overrides DomainName=$npm_package_config_domainProduction Certificate=$npm_package_config_certificate Stage=$STAGE RDSHost=$RDS_HOST RDSDBName=kofc_golf  DbHost=$DB_HOST TokenSecret=$TOKEN_SECRET DbUserName=$DB_USERNAME DbName=$DB_NAME DbPassword=$DB_PASSWORD NodeEnv=$NODE_ENV CacheId=$npm_package_config_cacheIdProduction --region $npm_package_config_region --no-fail-on-empty-changeset --force-upload
scripts.package-deploy-stage: npm run sam:build && npm run sam:deploy:stage
scripts.package-deploy-stage-dry: npm run sam:build && npm run sam:deploy:stage:dry
scripts.package-deploy-production: npm run sam:build && npm run sam:deploy:production
scripts.setup: npm run setup-stage && npm run setup-production
scripts.setup-stage: npm install && (cross-var aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketNameStage --region $npm_package_config_region || npm run create-bucketStage) && npm run package-deploy-stage
scripts.setup-production: npm install && (cross-var aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket $npm_package_config_s3BucketNameProduction --region $npm_package_config_region || npm run create-bucketProduction) && npm run package-deploy-production
scripts.deploy-stage: npm run environment && npm run build && npm run package-deploy-stage
scripts.deploy-production: npm run environment && npm run build && npm run package-deploy-production
scripts.environment: cross-env DB_USERNAME=$DB_USERNAME DB_PASSWORD=$DB_PASSWORD DB_HOST=$DB_HOST RDS_DB=$RDS_DB NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV  DB_NAME=$DB_NAME  TOKEN_SECRET=$TOKEN_SECRET STAGE=$STAGE
